title: Data Annotator
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.


Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.


About the Role


Job Title: Data Annotator

Employment Type: Freelance / Project-Based

Location: Remote (Work From Home)

Work Hours: Flexible; minimum commitment of 4–5 hours per day

Eligibility: Open to candidates with a Bachelor’s degree



We are seeking Data Annotator to support a data annotation and linguistic quality project aimed at training Large Language Models (LLMs) . This is a freelance, remote opportunity that offers flexible working hours.

The role involves understanding cultural and linguistic nuances, reviewing and annotating data, and following detailed project-specific guidelines to enhance AI performance and accuracy.


Key Responsibilities


  • Perform data annotation, and text evaluation in accordance with project-specific guidelines.
  • Ensure high-quality, accurate, and contextually relevant annotations to support Large Language Model (LLM) training.
  • Review, validate, and refine AI-generated content for grammatical, semantic, and contextual accuracy.
  • Maintain consistency and quality across all deliverables while adhering to established project standards and timelines.
  • Collaborate effectively with the project team to provide feedback and contribute to continuous improvement.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with all project deadlines and quality assurance protocols.


Required Skills & Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in mandatory.
  • Good proficiency in the English language
  • Prior experience in data annotation , linguistic evaluation , or AI training projects.


What Makes This Role Exciting


  • .Fully remote opportunity , allowing you to work comfortably from home.
  • Flexible working hours (4–5 hours per day) to suit your schedule.
  • The chance to contribute to cutting-edge AI and Large Language Model (LLM) training initiatives , shaping the future of language technology.


Note:

For this role, you are required to complete the English assessment within two (2) days from the date it is assigned to you.

title: Director of Government Affairs – Latin America
description:
Sherwin-Williams | Director of Government Affairs – Latin America (Brazil Focus)


Sherwin-Williams is a multinational company present in more than 120 countries and operating in Brazil for over 85 years, delivering innovative coating, protection, and manufacturing solutions across multiple industries.


We are seeking a Director of Government Affairs – Latin America , with a strong focus on Brazil, to lead and implement a cohesive government affairs strategy that supports the company’s business objectives and advances interests across the region.


This role will serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership, representing the organization with government entities, regulators, and industry associations, while proactively identifying political, regulatory, and policy trends that may impact the business.


Location

São Paulo – SP, Brazil

Hybrid | Regional Scope (Latin America)


Key Responsibilities

Government Affairs Leadership – Latin America (Brazil-Focused)

• Design, develop, and lead coordinated government affairs strategies that protect the company’s value, enhance its reputation, and support long-term business growth in Latin America, with primary focus on Brazil.

• Establish and maintain strong, ethical, and transparent relationships with key government stakeholders at national, state, provincial, and local levels, including regulatory agencies, ministries, and public institutions.

• Represent the company with industry associations, trade organizations, and think tanks relevant to the coatings, chemical, and manufacturing sectors (e.g., Abrafatti, Anapafyt, ABIQUIM).

• Monitor, analyze, and interpret political, legislative, and regulatory developments, advising senior leadership on potential business impacts and strategic response options.

• Analyze proposed legislation and public policy initiatives, developing and advocating appropriate positions aligned with the company’s interests.

• Lead lobbying and advocacy efforts with government bodies, committees, and industry groups.

• Coordinate closely with regional functional experts (Legal, Tax, Finance, Product Stewardship, Operations, EHS, HR) to ensure alignment on policy priorities and business strategy.

• Manage and oversee government affairs consultants across key countries and regions.

• Ensure all interactions with government entities are conducted ethically, legally, and in compliance with company policies and local regulations.

Support to Investment & Footprint Projects

• Provide government affairs support for new investments, expansions, site openings, closures, or consolidations.

• Advise leadership on political, regulatory, and stakeholder considerations related to strategic footprint decisions.

• Support communication strategies related to major investment and operational initiatives.

External Affairs & Community Engagement

• Respond accurately and promptly to government inquiries while protecting the company’s confidential and competitive information.

• Prepare briefing materials and talking points for meetings and engagements involving government officials.

• Support high-level engagements between Sherwin-Williams executives and government representatives in Latin America and the U.S.

• Promote and participate in relevant community relations and corporate citizenship initiatives aligned with business and reputation goals.


Requirements

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Public Affairs, Political Science, Business Administration, or related field

• Master’s degree in related field (preferred)


Experience & Knowledge

• 10+ years of experience in Government Affairs / Government Relations, preferably within manufacturing, chemical, or similarly regulated industries.

• Deep knowledge of Latin American political, regulatory, and policy-making environments, with strong emphasis on Brazil.

• Established network of senior-level government and industry relationships.

• Proven experience influencing public policy, negotiating with regulators, and building consensus across stakeholders.

• Experience working within or closely with government bodies is a strong advantage.

• Solid understanding of Brazil’s anti-corruption landscape.

• Ability to operate effectively in politically dynamic environments and engage across party lines.


Skills & Competencies

• Strong leadership and people management capabilities, including leading through influence.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strategic mindset with strong judgment, integrity, and ability to drive results.

• Comfortable interacting with senior executives, government officials, and external stakeholders.


Languages

• English and Portuguese – Fluent (mandatory)

• Spanish – Desirable

title: Medical Science Liaison (MSL) - Neurosciences
description:
About Eisai

The corporate concept of Eisai is “to give first thought to patients and to people in the daily living domain, and to increase the benefits that healthcare provides.” Under this concept (also known as the human health care – hhc – concept ), our goal is to effectively achieve social good by alleviating anxiety related to health and reducing health disparities.

With a global network of R&D facilities, manufacturing sites, and marketing subsidiaries, we strive to create and deliver innovative products for diseases with high unmet medical needs, with a special focus on our strategic areas of Neurology and Oncology .

In addition, we demonstrate our commitment to eliminating neglected tropical diseases (NTDs), a target (3.3) of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), through a variety of initiatives carried out in collaboration with global partners.


About This Position

The MSL will be responsible for working predominantly in the field (approximately 90% of the time), representing the company’s medical affairs area and operating in a dual-path function: bringing the medical strategy to the field and bringing strategic insights from the field back into the organization, contributing to the development of medical initiatives.


Main Responsibilities

  • Work in the field to disseminate the company’s medical strategy and conduct high-level scientific interactions.
  • Build and strengthen the KOL panel, ensuring medical interactions aligned with product strategy (short-term challenge).
  • Collect and bring field insights to the internal team, contributing to medical strategy development.
  • Reinforce Eisai’s institutional positioning in the medium term, increasing the medical community’s knowledge of the company.
  • Act with deep scientific understanding of molecules and treatments.
  • Gradually expand the territory of activity as relationships with stakeholders evolve.
  • Work with priority therapeutic area – Neurosciences.
  • Ensure compliance with industry regulations (Anvisa, Interfarma).
  • Availability for travel, including car travel (active driver’s license).


Technical Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in a health-related field: physician, pharmacist, biologist, nurse, or biomedical scientist.
  • Master’s or PhD: an important differential, but not mandatory.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience as an MSL and/or field-based work in the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Previous experience in Neurosciences (it will be a strong advantage).
  • Advanced English.


Desired Profile

  • Strong relationship-building skills.
  • Solid understanding of pharmaceutical industry compliance regulations (Anvisa, Interfarma).
  • Openness to learning and continuous development.
  • Ability to represent the company and convey to the market who Eisai is, contributing to greater brand recognition.


Compensation:

  • CLT contract
  • Performance Bonus: Target at 20% of the annual fixed salary
  • Hybrid work
  • No fixed working hours will apply, as the position of trust with duties incompatible with controlled timekeeping.


Benefits:

  • Car: Company Lease
  • Fuel Allowance
  • Meal Voucher (R$ 2.100,00 per month)
  • Health insurance + Dental Coverage (SulAmerica) including dependents coverage
  • Private life insurance (Provided by MetLife)
  • Private Pension Plan (Itaú 6%, 1x1) 
  • Medication Subsidy (Vidalink 50%)


Join us in shaping the future of patient-centered innovation and become part of a company where your work truly makes a difference.

title: Consultora (or) Manutenção Mecânica
description:
Sobre a vaga

O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.



Sobre a Arauco Brasil

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.


Objetivo geral do cargo:

Garantir que equipamentos e sistemas da sua área de atuação, funcionem de forma eficiente e segura, evitando paradas não programadas e interrupções da produção por manutenções de emergência, através de monitoramento de desempenho e demais indicadores, assegurando custos de manutenção adequados, planos de manutenção eficientes e gestão técnica dos times de manutentores.


Atividades Principais:

  • Criar e otimizar planos de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva, dos equipamentos de sua área de atuação, estabelecendo cronogramas de manutenção e garantindo e execução da manutenção com a eficiência necessária evitando quebras e impactos na produção;
  • Monitorar o desempenho dos equipamentos e sistemas, utilizando ferramentas de diagnóstico e análise de dados, identificando padrões de falhas, criando e implementando ações para melhorar a confiabilidade e disponibilidade dos equipamentos;
  • Treinar e orientar tecnicamente os times de manutenção, nos procedimentos e melhores práticas, promovendo a melhoria contínua das habilidades e conhecimento, bem como, assegurando que o time esteja treinado e capacitado para assumir as atividades de manutenção após o startup da planta, disponibilizando ferramentas, recursos técnicos e humanos para apoiar os fornecedores dos equipamentos e tecnologias;
  • Realizar análise dos modos de falha (FMEA) dos sistemas e equipamentos críticos da área de atuação, realizar análise de falha e aplicar metodologia e ferramentas de engenharia (RCA, FTA, RCM, Ishikawa, etc.);
  • Elaborar escopos de contratação de serviços terceirizados de manutenção, participando ativamente das etapas de negociação e avaliação técnica, assegurando as melhores práticas, custos adequados, qualidade, segurança e a confiabilidade em todo o processo;
  • Implantar, monitorar e analisar diariamente os indicadores de desempenho da sua área de atuação (Custos, disponibilidade, produtividade, estoque de peças de reposição etc.), viabilizando ajustes no planejamento, procedimentos e nos processos;
  • Outras atividades correlatas.


Requisitos do Cargo

Formação:

  • Graduação Técnico Mecânica, Mecatrônica e /ou áreas correlatas
  • Graduação Superior em Administração, Engenharias e/ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável Especialização em Manutenção Industrial, Gestão de Projetos, Lean Manufacturing e afins


Experiência:

  • Métodos de análise de falhas: FMEA, RCA, RCM;
  • Comissionamento e startup de plantas de Celulose e/ou Papel;
  • Conhecimento em Metrologia, Medição de dimensional com Instrumentos;
  • Conhecimento em sistemas dedicados, equipamentos rotativos (redutores, bombas, agitadores, ventiladores);
  • Conhecimento em técnicas preditivas mecânicas.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Expand your horizons and bring the technology closer to people with BGI #OMICSFORALL


BGI Genomics was founded in 1999 with the vision of using genomics to benefit mankind and has since become the largest genomic life science organization in the world. With a focus on research and applications in the healthcare, agriculture, conservation, and environmental fields, BGI has a proven track record of innovative, high-profile research, which has generated over 2,000 publications, many in top-tier journals such as Nature and Science. BGI now operating and serving customers in more than 100 countries and areas and with around 10,000 employees all over the world.


Our mission is to transform people’s lives for the better. We don’t hesitate to take bold decisions that can help us to achieve new breakthroughs. We believe that the success of our business will mean a better world for people to live in.


Our message to the world is simple – make everyone’s life healthier and longer with help of BGI.


Why joining us?


Here at BGI we bring the most talented and dedicated to science and business professionals to act as one to deliver the outstanding technology and services to people.


Our multicultural team is engaged in a challenging work that brings satisfaction and unlimited professional growth. We keep learning and upgrading ourselves, we support each other in order to achieve the best result.


Why do we want you?


We invite to partner only the best experts who will work side by side promoting BGI’s values, products and services. And that’s why, we are confident that your business expertise and deep knowledge of genomics will help us deliver our message to the world and build strong relationship with a community.



Job Purpose & Principal Accountabilities:


1. Responsible for formulating and implementing an effective sales plan, achieving the regional sales goals within the forecasted budget, and developing a key account sales strategy.

2. Understand and master the company's current portfolio of products and services. Stay abreast of technology developments, market competition, laws, and regulations relevant to the business. Use resources and research to identify the sales plan and strategy for different market segments.

3. Carry on regional business analysis and report to regional managers regularly. Evaluate the budget performance, product performance, and operational efficiency, and report recommendations and results to the team's leader.

4. Screen for relevant business opportunities in R&D, clinical and pharmaceutical fields. Develop and maintain relationships with key opinion leaders; use clients' resources and feedback to expand the influence of BGI and safeguard key market opportunities.

5. Work in coordination with project managers, production teams, and others to guarantee the smooth implementation of the project and timely and correctly communicate the project status to the clients. Work with product managers to promote product development through collaboration with key customers.

6. Participate in national and regional conferences, trade fairs, and company meetings.

7. Understand BGI's values and expand BGI's vision in overseas markets.


Job Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:


1. In-depth knowledge of NGS and IVD markets and customer needs in this industry.

2. In-depth knowledge of selling next-generation sequencing and other genomic services such as microarray, genotyping, in vitro diagnosis, etc.

3. Experience with government relations and lobbying for the pharmaceutical and biotech industry.

4. Excellent communication, analytical and organizational skills.

5. Willingness to travel.

6. Fluency in English, (Chinese preferred )

7.Base Sao Paulo.


Competences:


a. At least two years of experience in customer management in the biotechnology or Healthcare industry.

b. A Bachelor's Degree or above in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, bioinformatics or equivalent.


Here at BGI we value people and consider our employees as partners. Transparent, fair and friendly environment is what we created here. Agile approach in management is what we implement here and we give each partner enough independence as well as guidance. We take care of our partners’ physical and mental health and we are dedicated to the life-work balance corporate culture.


Not only do we bring genomics closer to people, we also participate in various charity programs, advocate nature preservation, and support equality. We condemn any discrimination and committed to giving job opportunity to everyone regardless of sex, race, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, pregnancy, military or veteran status, citizenship status etc.


· What do we offer?


1. International, cross-cultural, and cross-functional team

2. work with advanced technology and products

3. comprehensive onboarding program

4. continuous knowledge and skills development

5. HQ organized training globally and in China

6. official permanent work agreement and all social benefits

7. annual performance bonus

8. team building activities

9. salary range BRL 7.500 - 11.500 gross monthly.


Let’s move to the brighter and more equal future together and deliver #Omicsforall
